premises.text: Hiring fails often because candidates and employers decide on the wrong data: hidden jobs, soft-skill mismatch, and resumes that only show hard skills
premises.evidence_span: everyone, both candidates and employers, are making decisions based on the wrong data

premises.text: Cognitive assessments of soft skills are the most accurate job-performance predictors but are long, expensive, and slow, so almost no one uses them
premises.evidence_span: these tests are long and grueling, they're expensive, and they can take days or weeks to administer and get results

premises.text: Scoutable's 20-minute science-based mobile games quantify soft skills into a cognitive fingerprint and match candidates to top-performer profiles
premises.evidence_span: In just 20 minutes, our science-based mobile games measure and quantify soft skills to match perfect fit candidates to top jobs

premises.text: Companies pay a setup fee for a top-performer predictive model plus subscription filtering or sourcing fees; games are free for candidates
premises.evidence_span: Companies like Cloud Co pay us a one-time setup fee for creating the predictive model based on their top performers, and then a subscription for filtering inbound candidates against that model, or a sourcing fee

value.text: Help companies build world-class teams by matching perfect-fit soft-skill talent
value.evidence_span: how we help companies build world-class teams

secondary_value.text: Candidates learn about their own unique talents
secondary_value.evidence_span: free for anyone to download and play to learn more about themselves and their own unique talents

causal_links.evidence_span: match perfect fit candidates to top jobs
